lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰੇ ਸੇਈ ਆਗੈ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਮਾਣੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: soore seee aagai aakheeahi daragah paavahi saachee maano ||
lines.translation: They alone are acclaimed as brave warriors in the world hereafter, who receive true honor in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਣੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਆਗੈ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: daragah maan paavahi pat siu jaavahi aagai dookh na laagai ||
lines.translation: They are honored in the Court of the Lord; they depart with honor, and they do not suffer pain in the world hereafter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar ek dhiaavahi taa(n) phal paavahi jit seviai bhau bhaagai ||
lines.translation: They meditate on the One Lord, and obtain the fruits of their rewards. Serving the Lord, their fear is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚਾ ਨਹੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: oochaa nahee kahanaa man mahi rahanaa aape jaanai jaano ||
lines.translation: Do not indulge in egotism, and dwell within your own mind; the Knower Himself knows everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਮੁਣਸਾਂ ਸੂਰਿਆ ਹਕੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਮਰਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੋ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: maran munasaa(n) sooriaa hak hai jo hoi marahi paravaano ||3||
lines.translation: The death of brave heroes is blessed, if it is approved by God. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਾਬਾ ਰੋਈਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kis no baabaa roeeai baajee hai ihu sa(n)saaro ||
lines.translation: Nanak: for whom should we mourn, O Baba? This world is merely a play.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: keetaa vekhai saahib aapanaa kudarat kare beechaaro ||
lines.translation: The Lord Master beholds His work, and contemplates His creative potency.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਧਾਰਣ ਧਾਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kudarat beechaare dhaaran dhaare jin keeaa so jaanai ||
lines.translation: He contemplates His creative potency, having established the Universe. He who created it, He alone knows.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape vekhai aape boojhai aape hukam pachhaanai ||
lines.translation: He Himself beholds it, and He Himself understands it. He Himself realizes the Hukam of His Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kichh keeaa soee jaanai taa kaa roop apaaro ||
lines.translation: He who created these things, He alone knows. His subtle form is infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਾਬਾ ਰੋਈਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kis no baabaa roeeai baajee hai ihu sa(n)saaro ||4||2||
lines.translation: Nanak: for whom should we mourn, O Baba? This world is merely a play. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦਖਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 1 dakhanee ||
lines.translation: Wadahans, First Mehl, Dakhanee:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਚੜਾ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sira(n)daa sachaa jaaneeai sachaRaa paravadagaaro ||
lines.translation: The True Creator Lord is True - know this well; He is the True Sustainer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੀਨੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਸਚੜਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin aapeenai aap saajiaa sachaRaa alakh apaaro ||
lines.translation: He Himself fashioned His Own Self; the True Lord is invisible and infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਪੁੜ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: dui puR joR vichhoRian gur bin ghor a(n)dhaaro ||
lines.translation: He brought together, and then separated, the two grinding stones of the earth and the sky; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਸਿਰਜਿਅਨੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sooraj cha(n)d sirajian ahinis chalat veechaaro ||1||
lines.translation: He created the sun and the moon; night and day, they move according to His Thought. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੜਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਚੜਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaRaa saahib sach too sachaRaa dehi piaaro || rahaau ||
lines.translation: O True Lord and Master, You are True. O True Lord, bless me with Your Love. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh sirajee medanee dukh sukh devanahaaro ||
lines.translation: You created the Universe; You are the Giver of pain and pleasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਿਰਜਿਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: naaree purakh sirajiai bikh maaiaa mohu piaaro ||
lines.translation: You created woman and man, the love of poison, and emotional attachment to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਦੇਹਿ ਜੀਆ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaanee baanee tereeaa dehi jeeaa aadhaaro ||
lines.translation: The four sources of creation, and the power of the Word, are also of Your making. You give Support to all beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਸਚਿ ਨਿਬੇੜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kudarat takhat rachaaiaa sach nibeRanahaaro ||2||
lines.translation: You have made the Creation as Your Throne; You are the True Judge. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਾ ਗਵਣੁ ਸਿਰਜਿਆ ਤੂ ਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavaa gavan sirajiaa too thir karanaihaaro ||
lines.translation: You created comings and goings, but You are ever-stable, O Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਬਧਿਕੁ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਕਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: ja(n)man maranaa aai gaiaa badhik jeeu bikaaro ||
lines.translation: In birth and death, in coming and going, this soul is held in bondage by corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੂਡੜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਬੂਡੜੈ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhoodaRai naam visaariaa boodaRai kiaa tis chaaro ||
lines.translation: The evil person has forgotten the Naam; he has drowned - what can he do now?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਦਿਆ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਵਣਜਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gun chhod bikh ladiaa avagun kaa vanajaaro ||3||
lines.translation: Forsaking merit, he has loaded the poisonous cargo of demerits; he is a trader of sins. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦੜੇ ਆਏ ਤਿਨਾ ਜਾਨੀਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਚੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaRe aae tinaa jaaneeaa hukam sache karataaro ||
lines.translation: The beloved soul has received the Call, the Command of the True Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: naaree purakh vichhu(n)niaa vichhuRiaa melanahaaro ||
lines.translation: The soul, the husband, has become separated from the body, the bride. The Lord is the Re-uniter of the separated ones.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਹਣੀਐ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਬਧੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: roop na jaanai sohaneeai hukam badhee sir kaaro ||
lines.translation: No one cares for your beauty, O beautiful bride.; the Messenger of Death is bound only by the Lord Commander's Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਲਕ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤੋੜਨਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: baalak biradh na jaananee toRan het piaaro ||4||
lines.translation: He does not distinguish between young children and old people; he tears apart love and affection. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਦਰ ਠਾਕੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਚੈ ਹੰਸੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੈਣਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: nau dar thaake hukam sachai ha(n)s gaiaa gainaare ||
lines.translation: The nine doors are closed by the True Lord's Command, and the swan-soul takes flight into the skies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਛੁਟੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਝੂਠਿ ਵਿਧਣੀਆ ਮਿਰਤਕੜਾ ਅੰਙਨੜੇ ਬਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa dhan chhutee muthee jhooth vidhaneeaa miratakaRaa a(n)nganaRe baare ||
lines.translation: The body-bride is separated, and defrauded by falsehood; she is now a widow - her husband's body lies dead in the courtyard.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੁਈ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਈਏ ਮਹਲ ਰੁੰਨੀ ਦਰ ਬਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: surat muee mar maaeee mahal ru(n)nee dar baare ||
lines.translation: The widow cries out at the door, "The light of my mind has gone out, O my mother, with his death."

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: rovahu ka(n)t maheleeho sache ke gun saare ||5||
lines.translation: So cry out, O soul-brides of the Husband Lord, and dwell on the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਜਾਨੀ ਨਾਵਾਲਿਆ ਕਪੜਿ ਪਟਿ ਅੰਬਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal mal jaanee naavaaliaa kapaR pat a(n)baare ||
lines.translation: Her loved one is cleansed, bathed in water, and dressed in silken robes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਜੇ ਵਜੇ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀਆ ਪੰਚ ਮੁਏ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaaje vaje sachee baaneeaa pa(n)ch mue man maare ||
lines.translation: The musicians play, and the Bani of the True Lord's Words are sung; the five relatives feel as if they too are dead, so deadened are their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਨੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੜੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaanee vichhu(n)naRe meraa maran bhaiaa dhrig jeevan sa(n)saare ||
lines.translation: "Separation from my beloved is like death to me!" cries the widow. "My life in this world is cursed and worthless!"

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਸੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਰ ਸਚੜੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai s jaaneeai pir sachaRai het piaare ||6||
lines.translation: But she alone is approved, who dies, while yet still alive; she lives for the sake of the Love of her Beloved. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਸੀ ਰੋਵਹੁ ਰੋਵਣ ਆਈਹੋ ਝੂਠਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tusee rovahu rovan aaeeho jhooth muthee sa(n)saare ||
lines.translation: So cry out in mourning, you who have come to mourn; this world is false and fraudulent.
